newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market down, selling seen on high caps.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market down, selling seen on high caps.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed weaker on Wednesday amid selling pressure on high caps throughout the day, while foreign and local investors remained reluctant to buy, traders said.
They said that many players were waiting for lower prices on high caps to make new purchases. In the meantime, they preferred investing in cheaper stocks.
"The downtrend will continue on Thursday when we expect that supply will still exceed demand," a trader said.
The VAB-RA all-share index fell by one percent from Tuesday's levels to 6,476.5 points.
Another two independent indices, based on average prices and market capitalisation, also fell. The BIG-OTC slipped by 1.46 percent to 4,856.31 points and CAS-RQ inched down 1.83 percent to 1,067.
The selling mood bit further into prices of oil refineries and cement makers, operators said.

Petromidia oil refinery closed 2,000 lei weaker at 38,000, while Petrobrazi, another refinery, fell 1,000 lei to 41,000. A third refinery in high demand in recent weeks, Arpechim, dropped 2,000 lei to 38,000.
Cement maker Romcim lost 6,000 lei and closed at 122,000 in thin trading.
Grain trading companies which gained some ground in the previous session under buying pressure, fell on Wednesday in quieter trading, one broker said.

Comcereal Constanta, one of the biggest local companies, lost 300 lei in late trading and ended at 6,700. Operators said they still belived that the trading companies would be in demand in the near future in anticipation of a bumper harvest.
Turnover fell on Wednesday to 20.8 billion lei from 26.9 billion previously.
